comment: Copy to oidc.local.json (gitignored, chmod 600). issuer/audience/jwksUrl may instead come from CALDAV_OIDC_ISSUER / CALDAV_OIDC_AUDIENCE / CALDAV_OIDC_JWKS_URL (env wins). subjects maps an IdP token subject (sub) to a local account username (stable ID). Subjects with no entry fail authentication. For Logto, issuer is the tenant endpoint ending in /oidc and jwksUrl is <issuer>/jwks. adminClaim/adminValue (optional): a verified token whose claim adminClaim equals or contains adminValue may use the admin plane (/admin/*).
